releaseName: Guided start and agents for signed-in accounts
summary: New people are asked how they want to start, and Home shows a Getting started guide with one hint line on each guided screen (#2790, #2791, #2792). The simple or full display choice is saved on the account, and Show everything opens every Advanced options section (#2788, #2789). Signed-in members see the Work journal and Notes from agents, can create agent tokens, and see every connected agent in one table (#2783, #2784, #2785). An organisation the operator creates starts on the Free plan instead of having no plan (#2781). The Balanced reviewer keeps a review whose findings lack ids and says why one is refused (#2796).
knownLimitations: Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model; without it the panel says so after Start. None of the career conversation fixes has been tried against a live model yet. Signed-in users get the written interview only: live voice shows with the owner token, and a Free plan's conversation counts against its 20 model calls a day until the plan rule is built (#2750). Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. A partial refund takes nothing back, self-service sign-up is not built, and whether prices include VAT is open (#2677). The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). Holding back a fact withholds the whole source passage it was quoted from. The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). On the hosted staging service, drafting needs model screening, which stays off there until Claude on Vertex AI is available. French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The Steps section appears only for runs the server executed since traces were recorded.
